title: Arb-certified finite-strength two-path Fisher ordering with a separate singular boundary chart

pre_flight.problem_match: Close K1744's named finite-strength seam at q=1/1024: compare the K1738 selected linear section with the K1728 fixed-raw-radii linear section by a whole-line interval proof, and type the u=q face separately.
pre_flight.current_state_rechecked: K1744 certified the algebraic chart and a floating gap only. It explicitly withheld finite-strength ordering because neither the transcendental integral nor its tails had an interval enclosure.
pre_flight.dependency_and_formula_pin: The run uses UV_CACHE_DIR=_local/uv-cache uv run --with python-flint==0.9.0. The cubic root, base chart, K1738 P,A direction, and K1728 beta direction are re-derived from K1744's exact formulas rather than imported from floating decimals.
pre_flight.scope: One concrete q and two explicitly named interior linear sections; no parameter-domain branch-and-bound and no optimizer claim.

method.channel: For a symmetric four-point law with squared radii a,b and total inner-radius mass p, t=sqrt(q/u), v=1-t, and u=3-[p a^2+(1-p)b^2].
method.positive_denominator_form: With D=p exp(-t a/(2v)) cosh(sqrt(t a)y/v)+(1-p) exp(-t b/(2v)) cosh(sqrt(t b)y/v), N defined by replacing cosh with radius times sinh, the Fisher density is t exp(-y^2/(2v))(N-sqrt(t)yD)^2/[v^(5/2)sqrt(2pi)D]. On every interior channel D is strictly positive; Arb proves its denominator balls exclude zero.
method.compact_enclosure: Split [-11,11] into 352 rational cells of width 1/16. On each cell integrate the midpoint Taylor polynomial through degree 10 and enclose the order-11 Taylor remainder with the order-11 coefficient ball evaluated over the entire cell.
method.tail_enclosure: For |Y|>R, use |E[X|Y]|<=r_max and Y=sqrt(t)X+sqrt(v)Z. The implication |Z|>(R-sqrt(t)r_max)/sqrt(v), exact Gaussian first and second tail moments, and Mills' bound Phi_bar(L)<=phi(L)/L give a certified two-sided Gaussian tail upper bound for each channel.
method.comparison: Integrate the difference density fixed minus selected on the compact interval, then enlarge it symmetrically by the sum of both nonnegative tail upper bounds.

singular_boundary_chart.chart: At fixed selected p, solve u=q by a=1-sqrt((2-q)(1-p)/p), with b=(1-pa)/(1-p).
singular_boundary_chart.typed_boundary: The exact chart has t=1 and v=0. The channel is the four-atom pushforward itself, not a Lebesgue density, so the positive-denominator interior formula is not evaluated there.
singular_boundary_chart.reason: Relative Fisher information with respect to the standard Gaussian requires an absolutely continuous density. The v=0 discrete law is singular, so the extended-value convention assigns +infinity without evaluating the interior formula.
singular_boundary_chart.effect_on_comparison: The singular face cannot supply a finite competitor to either certified interior value, but this does not exclude a separate remote interior branch with u>q.

certified_conclusion.whole_line_ordering: At q=1/1024, the K1738 selected linear section has strictly smaller finite-strength relative Fisher information than the K1728 fixed-raw-radii linear section.
certified_conclusion.strict_gap: J_fixed-J_selected is contained in the recorded positive Arb ball centered at 1.0628683073186459666e-13 with radius at most 5.75e-24.
certified_conclusion.tail_control: The combined absolute effect of both omitted |y|>11 tails is at most the upper endpoint of 5.4392663166370973e-27.
certified_conclusion.boundary_control: The nearest K1744 axis-frozen u=q intercept is handled as a distinct singular chart with extended Fisher value +infinity, never by substituting v=0 into the interior expression.

post_flight.strongest_overclaim_attack: Rejected: a certified ordering between two named q=1/1024 sections is not a branch-and-bound over the two-radius chart and does not prove either section globally optimal.
post_flight.strongest_counterexample_seam: A remote interior channel with u>q is untouched and could still beat the selected section; K1749 supplies no parameter-domain exclusion for it.
post_flight.reproducibility_seam: Replay requires exactly python-flint==0.9.0 through the pinned uv command. The compact proof, tail inequality, exact cubic isolation, and singular chart all replay without scipy, numpy, quadrature-order agreement, or binary-float promotion.
post_flight.scope_guard: No whole-chart optimizer, all-seed theorem, unrestricted stationary lower bound, source-owned action, physical prediction, or protected-state change follows.
